body.author: [private custody/context locator retained in source]
body.basis: Complete234 native core-function screening plus preserved qualified native scope and r1 adverse fidelity evidence. Explicit listed judgments, not a learned classifier, title filter or automatic all-to-all relation.

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A sampled event can be traced to an intelligible recorded occurrence; ambiguous classes are excluded, bounded or clearly labelled in results.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: what the recorded occurrence denotes, including work episode and lifecycle phase

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange event definitions, source examples, extraction rules and unresolved recording ambiguities between the analyst and source/domain custodians. Specific receiving decision: Analyst, data custodian and reviewer exchange the minimal trace evidence required to diagnose a result.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A reviewer can select a material finding and recover its contributing records and transformations, or see the exact provenance break.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: stable source/occurrence references and recoverable transformation provenance

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The same declared source snapshot and extraction rule reproduce the analysis population and explain material count differences.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: join keys, multiplicities, inclusion boundaries and event-to-source meaning

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange event definitions, source examples, extraction rules and unresolved recording ambiguities between the analyst and source/domain custodians. Specific receiving decision: Analyst proposes abstraction; domain participants test whether the resulting distinctions are sufficient for the decision.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A material finding states its abstraction level and has a traceable mapping and sensitivity result.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the raw-to-abstract event mapping and which distinctions a coarser activity loses

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange event definitions, source examples, extraction rules and unresolved recording ambiguities between the analyst and source/domain custodians. Specific receiving decision: Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Each reported interval identifies the events and lifecycle interpretation that establish its endpoints.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the identity and observed meaning of paired lifecycle endpoints, including unfinished work

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange event definitions, source examples, extraction rules and unresolved recording ambiguities between the analyst and source/domain custodians. Specific receiving decision: Analyst exposes ordering alternatives to the consumer; system timestamps alone do not settle the real chronology.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A conclusion is either invariant across plausible orders or qualified by the orders on which it depends.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: which events belong to an episode and which observed temporal/order constraints are actually warranted

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange event definitions, source examples, extraction rules and unresolved recording ambiguities between the analyst and source/domain custodians. Specific receiving decision: Analyst and data custodian review repair rules; domain participants distinguish atypical work from recording error.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Material repairs have reasons and consequences; users can identify which conclusions require the repair to be correct.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a defect hypothesis grounded in recording behaviour, with raw/derived alternatives retained

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange event definitions, source examples, extraction rules and unresolved recording ambiguities between the analyst and source/domain custodians. Specific receiving decision: The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Reported denominators correspond to the declared unit, and material exclusions and generalisation limits are explicit.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the question-specific event/case/object/decision population and its omissions/censoring

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: New collection has a stated use, bounded scope and retirement condition; unavailable detail remains an evidence limit.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: which additional collection would reduce the identified uncertainty and what exposure it creates

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange event definitions, source examples, extraction rules and unresolved recording ambiguities between the analyst and source/domain custodians. Specific receiving decision: Data consumer must not accept technical parsing as semantic validation.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: No assurance claim uses format conformity as sufficient evidence of the process or organisational reality.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a concrete separation between structurally valid records and justified event/work interpretation

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange event definitions, source examples, extraction rules and unresolved recording ambiguities between the analyst and source/domain custodians. Specific receiving decision: Data producer and tool consumer agree on accepted meanings and reject silent coercions.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Interchange retains the fields and relations required for the intended analysis, with any loss exposed.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the identifiers, multiplicities and interpretation conventions that an actual interchange must preserve

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange the chosen unit, object/identity relations, projection losses and model semantics with the consumer of the relation. Specific receiving decision: Analyst and domain consumer choose the unit; the database’s primary key is not an automatic answer to the business question.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The chosen case notion is explicit and conclusions that change under alternatives are identified.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: The actual analysis question and unit of responsibility; independently supplied event/object relations and alternative correlations; creation/closure and projection meanings. Supplying the question is material before the whole binding or completion result is established.
epm_receiver_operands.r6_prior_operand: the question-specific case notion and alternatives where a single identifier loses relationships

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange the chosen unit, object/identity relations, projection losses and model semantics with the consumer of the relation. Specific receiving decision: Data custodians establish identity conventions; analysts communicate relation meaning to the process consumer.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A shared event can be counted once while its participating objects and their types remain recoverable.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: typed object identity, participation multiplicity and changing relation semantics

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange the chosen unit, object/identity relations, projection losses and model semantics with the consumer of the relation. Specific receiving decision: Analyst explains distortion to the consumer before a repeated record is interpreted as repeated work.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Reported rework or duration claims identify whether projection duplicates events or changes the relation being measured.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: pre-flattening event/object cardinality and the metric-specific difference after projection

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange the chosen unit, object/identity relations, projection losses and model semantics with the consumer of the relation. Specific receiving decision: Model analyst establishes formal properties; domain participants check identity interpretations; neither formal result grants intervention authority.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The model’s formalism, supported constructs and scoped guarantee are stated without transfer to incompatible object models.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: actual object identity/lifecycle assumptions of the chosen object-centric formalism

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange the chosen unit, object/identity relations, projection losses and model semantics with the consumer of the relation. Specific receiving decision: Analyst and consumer jointly select a representation; maximal expressiveness is not a delegated objective.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The selected representation has a stated advantage over a cheaper adequate alternative and a known loss boundary.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the particular distinction lost by a cheaper representation and the real consumer of that distinction

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange the chosen unit, object/identity relations, projection losses and model semantics with the consumer of the relation. Specific receiving decision: Corpus reviewer maintains the denominator while avoiding double counting.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: EPM-017 remains visible and links to EPM-004; only the latter exports the mechanism as a retained candidate.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: semantic identity of the duplicate candidate with EPM004, not another activity-refinement mechanism

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange the chosen unit, object/identity relations, projection losses and model semantics with the consumer of the relation. Specific receiving decision: Consumer decides whether added relations are worth their acquisition and interpretation burden.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: No universal migration requirement is exported from this candidate.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a task-specific adequate simpler representation that defeats unconditional object-centric superiority

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Model producer communicates inductive bias to the analyst and decision consumer.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Each model is accompanied by a scoped claim: what it represents, what its construction guarantees and what remains hypothetical.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the supported observable vocabulary and sample meaning, separately from the algorithmic construction guarantee

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Analyst selects the method; foundational status is not evidence that it is the best operational choice.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Use of alpha is justified by scope or a baseline purpose rather than universal recovery claims.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: actual log/structural assumptions of a scoped alpha use, separately from its theorem

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Analyst proposes thresholds; domain consumer decides whether suppressed behaviour is important.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The resulting model identifies its filtering settings and important conclusions are checked against plausible alternatives.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: meaningful activity frequencies, cases and material exceptions affected by thresholds

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Algorithm establishes its scoped construction property; analyst and domain consumer judge whether the representation fits the question.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The reported guarantee names the model class and does not equate soundness with truth, precision or normative correctness.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the log interpretation used to claim correspondence to work, separately from constructed soundness

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Model analyst chooses the formal objective; a solver’s optimum is not an organisational objective by default.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The result identifies the constraint problem solved and the assumptions needed to interpret its solution.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the meaning of log-derived region/ILP constraints, separately from solving the stated formal problem

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Analyst explains rule semantics; domain participants evaluate meaningful activation; rule authority is a separate decision.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A reported constraint includes its activation basis, scope and interpretation, not just a high support number.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: finite-trace boundaries, event abstraction and activation counts, not authority for mined constraints

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Analyst chooses the search objective and stopping condition; the optimiser cannot supply the missing definition of a useful process.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Results report objective, budget and stochastic variability alongside the selected model.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the evidence population and behavioural objective evaluated in a stochastic search, not global optimality

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Analyst constructs the view; participants judge its adequacy for the discussion, not merely its visual attractiveness.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The consumer can identify the represented scope and retrieve material suppressed behaviour.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: recoverable detail and an abstraction that preserves the actual communication question

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Domain participants explain consequence and authorisation; the miner supplies frequency, not importance.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Important infrequent behaviour remains visible in the evidence or its deliberate exclusion is justified.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: whether an infrequent occurrence is a material case/exception rather than a duplicated or wrongly attributed record

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Analyst communicates what is and is not identified; domain evidence can discriminate but must not be silently smuggled into the log.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Claims distinguish observed support, model permission and warranted process necessity.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: observable equivalence and which alternative event/work interpretations the data cannot distinguish

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Domain experts supply contextual knowledge; the relevant institutional actor—not the analyst—authorises prescriptive rules.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A consumer can tell which parts of the model were mined, interpreted or supplied as intended behaviour.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: traceable domain input about identity, lifecycle and observation, kept distinct from prescribed behaviour

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the representation, discovery bias, filtering and guarantee scope; keep domain-supplied knowledge distinguishable from mined evidence. Specific receiving decision: Analyst communicates what a local result does not say; the consumer decides whether a global conclusion is needed.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Each fragment’s scope and unresolved composition obligations are explicit.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: fragment event selection, shared-event boundaries and interactions omitted by a local decomposition

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Every material deviation states what it deviates from and the authority, if any, behind that reference.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: Reference origin/type, case/object scope, abstraction/meaning, version/window applicability and bounded rival explanations; mandate/approving actor independently established.
epm_receiver_operands.r5_prior_operand: the work/observation scope and version to which a stated reference is applied, not the authority of that reference

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the reference origin, comparison semantics and rival explanations of mismatch to participants and actors entitled to choose a remedy. Specific receiving decision: Analyst presents replay diagnostics to model and process experts; they evaluate possible explanations.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The consumer can identify which replay assumptions and token discrepancies produced the result.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: trace identity, event mapping and incompleteness used for the particular replay diagnosis

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A reported alignment states its cost model, search status and the semantics of each deviation category.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the event/model move vocabulary and admitted trace, separately from the chosen alignment cost and search result

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the reference origin, comparison semantics and rival explanations of mismatch to participants and actors entitled to choose a remedy. Specific receiving decision: Analyst establishes joint comparison; domain or rule authority interprets the guard and its consequence.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The diagnosis identifies the perspectives and assumptions needed to support it.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the data/resource/time binding and lifecycle scope actually used in the multiperspective comparison

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the reference origin, comparison semantics and rival explanations of mismatch to participants and actors entitled to choose a remedy. Specific receiving decision: Analyst explains bound semantics; the consumer decides whether the interval is informative enough to act on.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A result distinguishes robust mismatch from mismatch that depends on an unresolved event interpretation.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the admitted event/identity/occurrence alternatives over which conformance costs are bounded

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The decision record identifies the evidence that distinguishes the adopted explanation from material alternatives.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: discriminating source facts for data, reference, execution and exception explanations of the actual mismatch

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the reference origin, comparison semantics and rival explanations of mismatch to participants and actors entitled to choose a remedy. Specific receiving decision: Competent external authorities or accountable decision makers, not the mining algorithm, determine the additional predicates.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: No unconditional legal, ethical or organisational endorsement is inferred from a fitness or alignment score.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a concrete distinction between observation and normative authority, not a general legal or fairness verdict

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate the reference origin, comparison semantics and rival explanations of mismatch to participants and actors entitled to choose a remedy. Specific receiving decision: Model maintainer can repair a descriptive model within mandate; changing an obligation requires its own authorised actor and process.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The chosen correction has a supported cause, a stated change boundary and a checked effect on previously meaningful behaviour.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the diagnosed data/model/execution mismatch and preserved prior scope for an authorised correction

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate experimental units, actual metric definitions, missing results and task-specific trade-offs rather than only an aggregate score. Specific receiving decision: Analyst explains the measures; the consumer supplies the decision priorities rather than allowing a metric package to choose them.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A selection rationale states which trade-off was accepted and does not imply that a good score on one dimension establishes the others.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the declared log population and interpretation used by the selected quality dimensions, not a single quality score

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate experimental units, actual metric definitions, missing results and task-specific trade-offs rather than only an aggregate score. Specific receiving decision: Analyst interprets the measure; decision consumers must not equate the score with an externally validated false-behaviour rate.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The reported precision result names what it measures and the important limitations that can change the ranking.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the observed vocabulary and representation to which a particular precision definition is applied, not its axioms

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate experimental units, actual metric definitions, missing results and task-specific trade-offs rather than only an aggregate score. Specific receiving decision: Analyst communicates population assumptions; domain consumer decides whether external validity is adequate for the planned use.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Generalisation claims identify the tested setting and uncertainty rather than treating a metric as direct access to the true process.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: Unseen target definition, experimental-unit/dependency meaning, grouping/split, actual evaluation boundary and the exact used synthetic generator support; no new event rows required for a definition.
epm_receiver_operands.r5_prior_operand: the sample-generating unit and dependence/selection boundary used for an unseen-behaviour claim

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate experimental units, actual metric definitions, missing results and task-specific trade-offs rather than only an aggregate score. Specific receiving decision: The actual consumer supplies evidence of usability; analysts should not substitute aesthetic preference for task performance.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The chosen representation allows the needed decision without hiding consequential alternatives.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: which identity/lifecycle distinctions the real user task must retain after simplification

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate experimental units, actual metric definitions, missing results and task-specific trade-offs rather than only an aggregate score. Specific receiving decision: Researcher designs the comparison; reviewer checks whether the conclusion follows from its units and assumptions.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Results state the denominator and split unit, retain adverse/missing results and avoid converting repeated runs into independent replications.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the experimental unit, dependence structure, split and denominator of the actual empirical comparison

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate experimental units, actual metric definitions, missing results and task-specific trade-offs rather than only an aggregate score. Specific receiving decision: The consumer specifies priorities; a metric designer cannot supply universal organisational preferences.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: No unconditional model-quality ranking is exported; any local scalar is labelled as a chosen decision rule.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a real noncommensurable or purpose-dependent distinction, not a new aggregate ranking

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate experimental units, actual metric definitions, missing results and task-specific trade-offs rather than only an aggregate score. Specific receiving decision: Analyst reports the narrow fitness result; consumer requires other evidence for stronger conclusions.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A perfect-fit result is not allowed to erase semantic, precision, generalisation or authority limitations.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a concrete case in which perfect formal fit coexists with an unsupported event/work interpretation

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A duration claim can be traced to its endpoints and does not silently equate elapsed time with labour.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the observed endpoint meanings, matching rules and incomplete intervals behind a duration

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A proposed bottleneck remedy states the evidence linking the recorded delay to the alleged mechanism.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: case-level evidence about omitted prerequisites and recording practices behind an apparent delay

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange traceable intervals and interaction patterns with operational participants; distinguish observed facts, proposed causes, agreed actions and consequences. Specific receiving decision: Analyst and operational consumer decide which context explains the decision-relevant variation.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A comparison identifies the contextual variables whose omission would change the interpretation.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the shared-object, cross-case and temporal state used to interpret a queue or load comparison

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The unit of a resource claim matches the verified meaning of the identifier.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the verified meaning of a recorded actor/resource field, without inventing a person from a technical account

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The network is labelled by its operational construction rather than by an unsupported social meaning.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the actual event-derived handoff unit and case/order semantics, without inferring a social relationship

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A comparison names its unit, material adjustment assumptions and groups for which evidence is insufficient.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the comparison unit, case mix, selection and censoring behind a subgroup contrast

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange traceable intervals and interaction patterns with operational participants; distinguish observed facts, proposed causes, agreed actions and consequences. Specific receiving decision: Analyst constructs scenarios; authorised decision makers choose whether and how to test them in reality.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A scenario result states which assumptions generate the advantage and what prospective evidence would be needed before wider use.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the calibration population, arrivals/completion/observation semantics of a stated scenario model

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The result has a known consumer, disposition and consequence test, including a legitimate no-action outcome.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the distinction between analytical delivery, an actual intervention and an observed outcome for its consumer

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate alarms, source/model version changes, retained history and alternative change explanations to actors able to investigate and revise. Specific receiving decision: Data and model custodians communicate changes; consumers know which temporal claim a result supports.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A result or decision can be matched to its data, model and reference regime.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the data, definition, extraction and observation regime under which a result is interpreted

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate alarms, source/model version changes, retained history and alternative change explanations to actors able to investigate and revise. Specific receiving decision: Analyst defines and evaluates detection; operational/model authorities decide what a confirmed change means.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: An alert carries its feature basis and uncertainty, and the response distinguishes detection from diagnosis.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the observed feature/window semantics against which a drift alarm is calculated

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate alarms, source/model version changes, retained history and alternative change explanations to actors able to investigate and revise. Specific receiving decision: Data custodian explains instrumentation; analyst evaluates the observed shift; process authority decides on operational consequences.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A drift disposition states whether evidence supports process change, observation change, both or an unresolved mixture.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: source/extraction/version facts that discriminate instrumentation change from work change

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate alarms, source/model version changes, retained history and alternative change explanations to actors able to investigate and revise. Specific receiving decision: Stream analyst or service operator discloses retention and delay to the decision consumer.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: An online result states what history it represents and how partial/late observations affect it.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the prefix, arrival, late-data and unfinished-case semantics of an online result

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate alarms, source/model version changes, retained history and alternative change explanations to actors able to investigate and revise. Specific receiving decision: Analyst may update a descriptive estimate within scope; rule owners or other entitled actors decide whether the intended process changes.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Observed drift cannot erase a prior obligation merely by changing the learned model.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the scope of the recent descriptive evidence compared with the independently authorised stable reference

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Communicate alarms, source/model version changes, retained history and alternative change explanations to actors able to investigate and revise. Specific receiving decision: Only the relevant authorised actor can revise an obligation; a detector has no such authority.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: No reference obligation changes solely because the observed behaviour changed.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a concrete observation-change explanation that defeats automatic normative normalisation of drift

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Every predictive input can be justified as available at the declared decision time.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: event/attribute availability and the identified decision occasion, not merely a latest value

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange decision-time inputs, uncertainty, feasible actions, causal assumptions and observed actions/outcomes with the actual operational recipient. Specific receiving decision: Researcher states the claim and split design; reviewer examines what excluded cases and dependence do to the result.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The evaluation can be reconstructed and does not treat future outcomes or dependent prefixes as independent unseen evidence.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: case/object dependence, prefix grouping, outcome availability and censoring for the claimed deployment

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Outputs distinguish probability calibration, marginal set coverage and individual uncertainty; unreliable regimes trigger qualified output or review.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: calibration-population identity and regime, separately from calibration, coverage and individual uncertainty

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange decision-time inputs, uncertainty, feasible actions, causal assumptions and observed actions/outcomes with the actual operational recipient. Specific receiving decision: Operational authority specifies available actions and resource limits; the analyst evaluates decision support within those bounds.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A claimed useful prediction has an available response and an evaluation matched to its timing and resource constraints.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the actual running case and decision-time information/action opportunity, separately from resource utility

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange decision-time inputs, uncertainty, feasible actions, causal assumptions and observed actions/outcomes with the actual operational recipient. Specific receiving decision: Analyst establishes the causal claim’s conditions; authorised decision makers decide whether a test or intervention is acceptable.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: An interventional claim states why the observational or experimental evidence identifies the proposed effect, and where it does not.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the treatment/outcome unit, timing and observed action, separately from causal identification assumptions

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Advice states its recipient, feasibility conditions and evaluation basis; acceptance and actual execution are distinguishable.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the observed actual recipient/action state and outcome, separately from mandate, capability and feasibility

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange decision-time inputs, uncertainty, feasible actions, causal assumptions and observed actions/outcomes with the actual operational recipient. Specific receiving decision: Analyst identifies changed validity conditions; operational authority decides continued use, revision or retirement based on new evidence.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: Post-intervention claims cite evidence from the relevant regime and do not recycle an invalidated pre-intervention evaluation.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: policy/intervention regime and observed action/outcome changes that can invalidate a prior evaluation

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange decision-time inputs, uncertainty, feasible actions, causal assumptions and observed actions/outcomes with the actual operational recipient. Specific receiving decision: Analyst supplies evidence; consumer judges cost and decision relevance rather than accepting architectural prestige.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: No unconditional deep-model preference is exported.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a fair common information/target population for a particular baseline comparison, not a general architectural preference

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Exchange decision-time inputs, uncertainty, feasible actions, causal assumptions and observed actions/outcomes with the actual operational recipient. Specific receiving decision: Researcher and operational evaluator must establish realised effects; a developer’s simulation is not a deployment verdict.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The packet exports an evidence obligation, not a presumed benefit or an unconditional control.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: Bounded formal, implementation, adoption, outcome and actual design-selection inputs can specify prospective delivery, comparator and burdens while broad benefit remains unresolved.
epm_receiver_operands.r5_prior_operand: a bounded local observation/evidence limit for prescription, with broad deployed benefit still unresolved

epm_receiver_operands.native_output: A competent reviewer can reproduce the declared computation or locate the exact blocked dependency.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: the actual data, transformations, versions and failed/excluded observations needed to reconstruct the computation

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Provide reviewers and participants with a usable, lawful analytical chain, relevant sensitivity results, data dependence and unresolved assumptions. Specific receiving decision: Analyst defines and reports sensitivity; reviewer challenges whether excluded alternatives were genuinely implausible.
epm_receiver_operands.native_output: The finding states which reasonable changes preserve it and which would reverse or weaken it.
epm_receiver_operands.operand: a plausible consequential identity/extraction/order alternative and its effect on the actual finding

epm_receiver_operands.native_communication: Provide reviewers and participants with a usable, lawful analytical chain, relevant sensitivity results, data dependence and unresolved assumptions. Specific receiving decision: Participants contribute situated evidence; authority to decide or revise policy remains distinct from expertise or seniority.

AUTHORITY.actual_shared_scope: An identified actor supplies the actual applicable mandate, constraint, interface agreement or discretion boundary for the receiving operation.
AUTHORITY.ceiling_and_negative_control: The issuer must possess the asserted authority. A model or analyst cannot invent it, and authorised action need not be feasible or effective.

AVAILABILITY.actual_shared_scope: The receiver consumes this exact value, binding, version or environment at a stated decision or evaluation time; the source supplies the relevant historical availability or explicit uncertainty.
AVAILABILITY.ceiling_and_negative_control: A present value is not past availability. Binding evidence does not prove the split design, predictive quality, causality or external truth.

CAUSAL.actual_shared_scope: The receiver uses the actual comparison, attribution limits, adverse outcomes or setting-specific evidence when making this consequence claim.
CAUSAL.ceiling_and_negative_control: An association or uncontrolled before/after result is not causal identification or broad deployed benefit. The receiving estimand and transport assumptions remain open.

CHANGE.actual_shared_scope: The actual changed definition, selected work, policy, case state or interpretation environment governs the evidence or action being compared; the communicated change affects a named receiving premise.
CHANGE.ceiling_and_negative_control: Change in work, model, capture and expectation are distinct. An unrelated change does not invalidate a result and compatible local/child change need not migrate a parent.

DECISION.actual_shared_scope: The actual result has this identified consumer, disposition, feasible action or observed feedback, and that fact changes the receiving use or renewal decision.
DECISION.ceiling_and_negative_control: Delivery, agreement, action and outcome are separate; no consumer or no intervention can make the coupling absent.

ENACTMENT.actual_shared_scope: The receiver uses the actual selected route, supported behaviour, work choice or independently checked proposed action as a constraint, context or observed action for this same work.
ENACTMENT.ceiling_and_negative_control: A prescribed or generated action is not an enacted action. Formal semantics, operative authority, adoption and received outcomes need their own evidence.

EXECUTION.actual_shared_scope: This mechanism actually executes, retains or transfers the selected analytical computation or evidence; its recipe, dependency identity, failure or retention boundary is used by the receiving claim.
EXECUTION.ceiling_and_negative_control: A scheduler graph, exit code or retained bytes does not certify scientific truth. A precise blocked dependency can be a valid reproducibility result; local scripts can suffice.

LIFECYCLE.actual_shared_scope: The receiving task consumes these actual item/branch/case states or their explicit mapping; open, suspended, cancelled and completed meanings change its endpoint, population, prefix, dependency or availability decision.
LIFECYCLE.ceiling_and_negative_control: A work item is not assumed identical to a case, cancellation is not success, and a status timestamp is not automatically event or availability time.

LIMITED.actual_shared_scope: No new operating output is attributed to this rejected, duplicate, superseded or broadly unresolved native claim.
LIMITED.ceiling_and_negative_control: Retain the original criticism, canonical alias or evidence obligation; do not manufacture a new mechanism from its standard communication field.

OBSERVATION.actual_shared_scope: This source/history/interchange account actually supplies the receiver with event meaning, attribution, version, omission or observation uncertainty for its selected records.
OBSERVATION.ceiling_and_negative_control: Capture and outside-world correspondence remain claim-relative. Richer logs are neither universally complete nor automatically permitted to disclose.

OUTCOME.actual_shared_scope: The receiving claim concerns this actual declared, accepted, effected, compensated or unresolved result, and the source evidence is matched to that exact consequence.
OUTCOME.ceiling_and_negative_control: Declaration, receipt, verified effect, remedy and full restoration remain different. No causal effect, universally reliable observation or mandatory independent witness follows.

PROTECTION.actual_shared_scope: The actual data use or release is subject to this stated purpose, access or affected-person constraint, which changes an admissible receiving choice.
PROTECTION.ceiling_and_negative_control: No universal anonymity, fairness definition, attacker proof or lawful authority is supplied by a generic protection label.

PURPOSE.actual_shared_scope: The actual receiving task consumes the declared outcome, protected consequence, priority or unit as its objective or interpretation boundary.
PURPOSE.ceiling_and_negative_control: An objective does not supply a log, an estimator, a deployed effect or universal commensurability.

REFERENCE.actual_shared_scope: The receiver uses this exact stated transition, constraint, model or checked guarantee at its declared version and supported formal scope.
REFERENCE.ceiling_and_negative_control: A scoped oracle can constrain a method without proving the complete receiver. Model inclusion, implementation, fairness, resources and outside effects remain separate.

REPRESENTATION.actual_shared_scope: The receiver consumes this actual representation, abstraction or semantic contract and a specified retained/lost distinction affects its method or claimed interpretation.
REPRESENTATION.ceiling_and_negative_control: Notation, elegance, syntax and formal validity do not establish domain truth, permission or implementation correspondence.

RESOURCE.actual_shared_scope: The receiving comparison or proposed action depends on these actual resource identities, assignments, calendars, constraints, queues or capacity states.
RESOURCE.ceiling_and_negative_control: Eligibility, authority, competence, availability and effectiveness remain separate; a role label or current workload cannot identify every person or past resource state.

SCENARIO.actual_shared_scope: The receiver actually consumes the stated calibrated scenario, assumptions, baseline or sensitivity for the same decision and population.
SCENARIO.ceiling_and_negative_control: A scenario forecast is not an observed intervention or proof of causal benefit; simpler arithmetic or a bounded trial can suffice.

SCOPE.actual_shared_scope: The receiving task uses these very cases, objects, variants, dependencies or inclusion boundaries; the stated source distinction changes its unit, population, mapping or scope.
SCOPE.ceiling_and_negative_control: A process boundary is not forced to equal an analytical case. Identity alone proves neither capture nor representative sampling.

SELECTION.actual_shared_scope: This exact candidate/use is considered for the same actual purpose and its function, burden or live consumer changes selection or retirement.
SELECTION.ceiling_and_negative_control: No mandatory installation or global minimum follows. The three original exhaustive selector owners remain authoritative for their unchanged scope.

TESTIMONY.actual_shared_scope: A concrete participant account, tested case distinction, omitted variant or recorded disagreement is actually delivered to the receiving inquiry about that same work.
TESTIMONY.ceiling_and_negative_control: Testimony is fallible. Consensus is not truth; an unrelated workshop or untested opinion supplies no discriminating fact.

body.r4_breadth: Reexamined all150 native producer postconditions/communication fields at P035/P041/P068 and both B016/B018 receiving frontiers. Retained sound r3 P064/P066 decisions. This declared scope is not a new global exhaustive-prose obligation.

r4_contract.forward: The stated native information is actually produced, communicated, scope-matched and consumed at the named receiving premise. Mere availability, an unperformed option, an unobserved world effect, or an arbitrary inferred measurement is insufficient. A return is not required.
r4_contract.limits: This is a partial premise. The receiver still owns its model, mapping, comparison, estimator, authority and sufficiency requirements. Native source qualifications and unknowns remain. No probabilities, true population, causal benefit or general field transfer are supplied.
r4_contract.return: An actual receiver result or instantiated evidence question has been produced, delivered back and used in the original producer function. A hypothetical request or useful forward input does not establish this orientation.
r4_contract.return_absence: A missing, undelivered or unused result defeats only the return. If the source account already serves its purpose, no revision is required. No reciprocity, new collection duty or operative authority follows from a forward edge.
